plans.scope: Portable font collections/fallback policy and richer paragraph corpus, preserving the existing CoreText/HarfBuzz ownership split. Verify mixed scripts, composed clusters, wrapping, selection, and invalidation; do not assume identical glyph IDs across engines.

Native ownership and lifecycle: instance-owned window state or an explicitly enforced bounded profile, then prove two windows cannot cross-route events/resources. Cover deep collection editing, native menu/dialog lifecycle, drag/drop, and automated AX assertions incrementally. Existing portable menu/dialog models are reused.

[Browser execution](docs/design/browser-execution.md): preserve the FDG probe, establish safe handles/capacity/runtime/toolchain boundaries, then connect actual Moxi events, scene output, rendering, semantics, and lifecycle. Define a supported subset before calling it a web target.

[Server-backed views](docs/design/server-backed-views.md): real delayed local transport, immediate client feedback, bounded queries/cancellation, stale-result rejection, capped exact-record details, disconnect/retry, and measured full-data comparison.

[Jupyter entry points](docs/design/jupyter-integration.md): fresh-kernel notebook using one graph for static SVG and nonblocking native launch, with repeated execution, errors, close/restart and explicit remote-kernel behavior.

[Interactive Jupyter](docs/design/jupyter-integration.md): example-local FDG widget/comm spike with bounded versioned messages, isolated outputs, disposal/rerun/restart, static saved fallback, and actual remote-kernel verification.

Reusable notebook adapter gate from the same [Jupyter plan](docs/design/jupyter-integration.md): add a genuinely distinct linked-selection plot consumer before generalizing; verify installation, keyboard/semantics and recovery.

[FDG follow-ups](docs/design/fdg-port.md): proposed finite choices are PNG/PDF export, clean local package installation, and a Linux native lane. Keep existing solver/app; measure larger graphs before any capacity/solver redesign.

[SeedWaterSegmenter](docs/design/sws-port.md): reproducible reference fixtures, native stack/label viewer, generation-safe watershed, seed/polygon editing, undo/redo, persistence, cancellation and recovery. Preserve scientific algorithms first.

[SWS4D](docs/design/sws4d-port.md): reference fixtures, linked XY/XZ/YZ/time viewer, explicit axes/spacing/connectivity, edits in each plane, watershed, stable IDs, bounded caches, persistence and recovery.

[Linux GPU H4](CROSS-PLATFORM-HOST-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md): choose an adapter through a scene/packet probe, retain GTK host and software oracle, then implement the declared text/image/clip/resource subset with parity and hardware measurements.

[Additional host H5](CROSS-PLATFORM-HOST-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md): separate iOS and Android compiler/runtime feasibility gates; promote each existing shell only when real shared Mojo application state executes.

[Host follow-through](CROSS-PLATFORM-HOST-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md): Wayland validation of the existing Linux host. Windows receives a bounded feasibility/design gate because only a portable descriptor exists; a full Windows host is not yet specified.

[Symbolic backend comparison](docs/design/math-backend-experiment.md): executable SymEngine wrapper and persistent SymPy worker against one exact-expression corpus; ownership, bounded work, revision/cancellation, editable result conversion, packaging and measured decision.

[Math editor M0–M4](docs/design/math-editing.md): lossless notation/text including holes/malformed edits; shared display/editor geometry, fractions/scripts/radicals/delimiters/matrices/functions/sums/integrals, navigation/selection, clipboard/history/persistence, one selected async backend, and second public-API consumer.

[Canvas C0–C4](docs/design/canvas-interaction.md): transformed ordinary components, shared geometry/input/semantics, pan/zoom/select/move/resize/history, ports/edges/reconnect, groups/minimap/culling and public consumers.

[Mind map N0–N4](docs/design/mind-mapping.md): keyboard-first ordered tree/layout, branch movement/reparenting, folds/search/outline, crosslinks/notes/style metadata, local save/recovery, bounded Freeplane import and visible loss report.

[Spatial S0](docs/design/3d-interaction.md): compare existing bridge with one credible renderer; establish depth, perspective/orthographic, compositing, frame/resource/coordinate contracts and measured choice.

[Spatial S1/S2](docs/design/3d-interaction.md): reactive geometry explorer, picking/selection/inspector, projected annotation, stale-work rejection, constrained transforms/snapping/numeric entry and shared undo.
[Spatial S3](docs/design/3d-interaction.md): second application with hierarchy, linked perspective/orthographic views, shared selection, measurement/clipping and resource/work reuse evidence.

[Spatial S4](docs/design/3d-interaction.md): planar world-space ordinary controls, ray/local mapping, occlusion/clip/capture/focus/IME/semantics; compare screen-space editing before promoting the API.

[Specialized Wave A](ECOSYSTEM-CONVERGENCE-PLAN.md#specialized-geometry-promotion-backlog--remaining-wave-a): upstream-shaped layouts/fixtures for lollipop, waterfall, candlestick, bullet, grouped/stacked bar, Gantt/span, population pyramid.

[Specialized Wave B](ECOSYSTEM-CONVERGENCE-PLAN.md#specialized-geometry-promotion-backlog--remaining-wave-b): pie/donut, radar, gauge, polar/radial bar, beeswarm, violin, ridgeline, Nightingale, streamgraph, contour; richer distributions/grids as needed.

[Specialized Wave C](ECOSYSTEM-CONVERGENCE-PLAN.md#specialized-geometry-promotion-backlog--remaining-wave-c): treemap, sunburst, tree, Sankey, chord, graph, calendar, corrplot, punchcard, Marimekko, barbs, tricontour.

[Native Mojo/CPython extension](ECOSYSTEM-CONVERGENCE-PLAN.md#gate-e4-python-binding-proof-and-package-skeleton): clean-environment native import/render probe, typed-buffer lifetime/copy policy, stable failures, wheel/dependency inspection and deployment decision. Preserve existing compiler-independent facade.

[Cairo scene/export evaluation](PROJECT-PLANNING.md#gate-4-supported-2d-plotting-package): canonical scene corpus adapter and maintenance/coverage/cost comparison; adopt only if evidence warrants it. Portable wgpu evaluation is owned by P09, not a duplicate worker.

Full-catalog reconciliation gate: current capability inventory additionally names parallel, funnel, bump, effect_scatter and arc_diagram outside A–C prose. Audit reference layouts and define remaining parity deltas before implementing any missing ones.

[NotImplemented component](docs/not-implemented-pattern.md): pure inert component, feature name/explanation, ordinary semantics, independent namespacing, public import, runnable example and Playground entry.

Chemical prediction investigation: replay one outcome/horizon with sensor traces, baseline comparison and held-out session evaluation.
